note: caiso-139 dump-guard recipe + MEASURED per-plant loaded CT heat rates (caiso-146) + MEASURED per-plant POWER-ONLY CHP heat rates (caiso-147, single-flag delta measured_chp_heat_rates=true, promoted 2026-07-31 on rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] AND rules 21/24 grounds). For a cogeneration plant eGRID does not publish total fuel per net MWh: it first removes the fuel share it attributes to useful thermal output, so the PLHTRT the model prices with is a STEAM-CREDITED rate, not the rate at which the machine turns fuel into power. CAISO compounded that by sitting in CHP_STEAM_CREDIT_HR_CORRECTION_ISOS, where the incumbent is the credited rate times an OFF-REGISTRY HAND FACTOR (x1.8 for a sub-8.0 CT_CHP, max(x1.15, 6.3) for a sub-6.0 CC_CHP) — one universal topping factor that caiso-128 §3 measured OVER-correcting CAISO CT_CHP by +40% while five ISOs sat 12-62% UNDER. This lever retires that hand number for eGRID's own published allocation undone: heat_rate = (PLHTIAN + CHPCHTI) / PLNGENAN, the incumbent rate with the useful-thermal heat input added back on the SAME net denominator, so no gross-to-net factor is involved (which is exactly what blocked the CEMS route, FINDING-miso98 §6.1). Zero fitted parameters (rule 24). CAISO's own artifact from CAISO's own data (rule 25 — MISO's K at miso-99 transferred nothing): 92 (plant, class) rows, 30 applied covering 2,371.8 MW; CC_CHP 11/21 rows at 67.2% of class capacity but 100.0% of the class's own metered CAMPD energy, CT_CHP 19/71 at 28.2% / 35.4%. Validated against independently metered CAMPD annual heat input at 13/13 plants within 1%, median ratio 1.00000 (MISO's was 19/22). The correction is TWO-SIDED AND OPPOSITE between the classes — CC_CHP cap-wt 6.779 -> 8.108 MMBtu/MWh (+19.6%, DEARER) and CT_CHP 11.935 -> 10.196 (-14.6%, CHEAPER) — caiso-128 §3's 'a universal factor is wrong in both directions at once', measured on CAISO's fleet. NO class moves away from actual. Total generation is identical to three decimals — pure reallocation. EVERY criterion verdict UNCHANGED from the control; determination CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS with 0 FAILs and the SAME 2 of 3 ledgered slots.
